validity.recommendation: keep Length/Diameter as-is; optionally tighten Length to 532.6 km per primary source
validity.researcher_notes: Existence and core route confirmed against TWO independent origins beyond the sheet's own gem.wiki citations: (1) Ukrtransgaz's own historical chronology page (archived, utg.ua), which states verbatim: '1987 р. ... введено в експлуатацію магістральний газопровід Кременчук - Ананьїв - Богородчани довжиною 532,6 км, ∅1020 мм' — i.e. the Kremenchuk-Ananiv-Bohorodchany trunk, 532.6 km, 1020 mm diameter. This matches GEM's Length=532.00 km (0.6 km / 0.1% rounding, immaterial) and Diameter=1020 mm exactly. (2) A KPMG 2017 report on Ukraine's gas transit system ('Situation of the Ukrainian natural gas market and transit system', hosted at readkong.com, verified live) independently lists this line in its pipeline abbreviations table as 'KACHB: Kemenchug-Ananijiv-Ananjiv-Bohorodchani', confirming it is treated as one continuous named trunk by a professional third party, not a GEM-only construct. Uk.wikipedia's article on this pipeline (cited by the sheet's own gem.wiki page) repeats the same 532 km / 1020 mm / 'up to 8.7 bcm/y toward Bohorodchany' figures, but traces to the same Ukrtransgaz chronology, so it does not count as a second independent number-source for capacity. Existence/route: high (2 independent origins). Length/diameter: medium (one strong primary source, matched by a derivative). Capacity 8.7 bcm/y: only found in the Wikipedia narrative, not independently pinned to a primary document — left unresolved rather than fabricated.

validity.recommendation: fix StartCountryOrArea from 'Russia' to 'Ukraine' for Kremenchug
validity.researcher_notes: Location error: the row's Location cluster records StartLocation='Kremenchug' with StartCountryOrArea='Russia'. Kremenchuk (Кременчук) is a major city in Poltava Oblast, central UKRAINE — it is not in Russia, has never been, and both the Ukrtransgaz chronology and Ukrainian Wikipedia describe this pipeline as an entirely domestic Ukrainian trunk (Kremenchuk, Poltava Oblast -> Bohorodchany, Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast). The worklist itself flags this cluster 'irregular': true, consistent with a data-entry defect. This should be corrected to StartCountryOrArea='Ukraine'.

validity.recommendation: correct Owner1 from 'Gazprom PJSC' (100%) to Ukraine's state GTS operator (historically Ukrtransgaz; since 1 Jan 2020, the assets/operatorship sit with the Gas TSO of Ukraine / ТОВ «Оператор ГТС України» structure) — do not leave Gazprom on a wholly domestic Ukrainian line
validity.researcher_notes: Owner1='Gazprom PJSC' at 100% is very unlikely to be correct. This pipeline runs entirely within Ukraine (Kremenchuk, Poltava Oblast to Bohorodchany, Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast per both the Ukrtransgaz chronology and uk.wikipedia) — it does not cross into Russia or Belarus, so there is no Gazprom-owned section to attribute. Ukraine's transmission system has been state-owned/operated since the Soviet era; Gazprom has never held equity in Ukraine's domestic GTS. This looks like a template/default value copied across rows rather than a researched fact for this specific pipeline (cf. the country-wide caution in the sweep brief that a Gazprom owner entry on a wholly-Ukrainian row is a standing attribution risk). I could not find a citable public source naming the current legal owner precisely enough to propose a replacement value without guessing, so this is flagged for Update rather than filled.

validity.recommendation: cluster-level adjudication vs P1481 (Ananjiv-Bohorodchani Gas Pipeline, 333 km, 1020 mm, 9.1 bcm/y) — check whether P1481 double-counts the Ananiv-Bohorodchany half of this same 532.6 km trunk
validity.researcher_notes: The Ukrtransgaz chronology (the operator's own line-by-line construction record for the whole Ukrainian network, spanning 1960s-1990s) names exactly ONE construction event for this corridor: 'магістральний газопровід Кременчук - Ананьїв - Богородчани довжиною 532,6 км, ∅1020 мм' (1986-87). It records no separate 'Ananiv-Bohorodchany' pipeline anywhere in the document. P1481 in the roster ('Ananjiv-Bohorodchani Gas Pipeline', Ananjiv->?, 333 km, dia 1020 mm, cap 9.1 bcm/y) shares P1485's exact diameter (1020 mm) and a very similar capacity (9.1 vs 8.7 bcm/y), and its endpoints (Ananiv -> Bohorodchany) are a strict subset of P1485's route (Kremenchuk -> Ananiv -> Bohorodchany). 532.6 - 333 = ~199.6 km, which would be a plausible Kremenchuk-Ananiv segment length. This has the classic signature of a segment-vs-network double count (the whole trunk recorded once as P1485 and its western half recorded again as P1481) rather than two genuinely distinct pipelines — but I have not found independent sourcing for P1481 itself in this pass, so I am flagging for adjudication rather than recommending a merge/fold outright, per the sweep brief's instruction not to resolve clusters solo.

validity.recommendation: change StartYear1 from 1985 to 1986 (initial commissioning) or 1987 (full 532.6 km / 1020 mm completion, matching GEM's recorded spec) — verify which convention the tracker wants
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records StartYear1=1985. The Ukrtransgaz chronology instead places this pipeline's commissioning at 1986 ('1986 р. Введено в експлуатацію магістральні газопроводи ... Кременчук - Ананьїв – Богородчани') with the full-spec entry (532.6 km, 1020 mm — the numbers matching GEM's current record) dated 1987. 1985 in the same document is the completion year for a DIFFERENT, nearby item — the Bohorodchany compressor station ('1985 р. Закінчено будівництво і введено в експлуатацію КС Богородчани') — which looks like the likely source of the sheet's 1985 date being confused with a compressor-station completion rather than the linear pipeline's own commissioning. Recommend Update verify and correct to 1986 or 1987.

summary: P1485 exists and its 532/1020mm route is confirmed by Ukrtransgaz's own construction chronology + an independent KPMG report, but the row carries a clear location error (StartCountryOrArea=Russia for Kremenchug, which is in Ukraine), a very likely wrong owner (Gazprom PJSC 100% on a wholly-domestic Ukrainian line), a StartYear1 (1985) that conflicts with the primary source's 1986/1987 dating, and a plausible segment-vs-network duplicate with P1481 (Ananjiv-Bohorodchani, 333km/1020mm) that needs cluster adjudication.
